subject: TEST
required_symbol_fields_reason: TEST reuses the Physics symbol rule so that a vector test package is judged the way a Physics one is: a symbol without its unit and dimension is not a checkable symbol.

requires: resultant labelled with tail and head
one length scale for every vector drawn
limits: a construction, not a component readout; VECTOR draws one vector against axes, and using it here would hide the reversal that the construction exists to show

subject_specific_notes.sandbox: TEST is a sandbox for stress runs. Nothing in it is curriculum, nothing in it is accepted or released, and no machine check here grants release. See TEST/README.md.
subject_specific_notes.no_validators: No subject validators exist for TEST, so no quantitative claim in TEST is machine-checked by this subject.
